Adventures ========== From Dungeon Defenders 2 Wiki Jump to: [navigation](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Adventures#mw-head) , [search](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Adventures#p-search) * Adventures is a game mode placed right after the [Campaign](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Campaign "Campaign") in progression. After completing Adventures, players should proceed to [Expeditions](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Expeditions "Expeditions") . * Completing Adventures is the one of two sources of [free gems](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Gems "Gems") in the game, Up to 450 gems. * It is recommended to finish Adventures to get all the rewards and so you won't have to go back while progressing through the [Questline](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Questline "Questline") . Rewards ------- All Rewards can only be obtained once.
